execution.task:
Generate today's tech news briefing using Horizon. Steps:
1. Clone https://github.com/Thysrael/Horizon.git if not exists
2. Install dependencies (uv sync or pip install -e .)
3. Configure AI provider (use available API keys)
4. Run: horizon generate --date today
5. Collect news from Hacker News, RSS, Reddit, GitHub
6. AI score and filter (min 6.0, max 20 items)
7. Generate bilingual summaries (EN/ZH)
8. Enrich with community discussions and background
9. Output formatted Markdown report
10. Display summary and key highlights
